input:
CURRENT SCENE:
有一天孟子去了墓地玩儿，但是他妈妈觉得这是不合适的地方让孩子玩，所以她决定了他们会搬家找更好的地方。她恐怕儿子的童年不会幸福，而且住在这儿教育不太好。因为她望子成龙，所以她会一直搬家才能找到质量好的教育。然后他们搬到了离城市更近的地方。

ITEMS:

[I50] 有一天【孟子】去了墓地玩儿   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: first appearance of 孟子: briefly introduce who this is
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子从早到晚想玩玩儿，所以他和朋友坐墓地在祭拜⟧ — her note: loosely connected with the preceding sentence
  her past correction: 孟子在墓地[-和]祭拜跟其他孩子
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧从早到晚想玩玩儿 — her note: replace孟子with他

[I51] 有一天孟子去【了】墓地玩儿   correction: 了 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (loose_clause_connection, Coherence: connectors): Make the relationship between clauses or sentences clear. Add or choose a connector, a purpose phrase, or a sequence marker that shows the real connection.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use <connector/purpose/sequence phrase> to show how this sentence connects to the previous clause or sentence.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子从早到晚想玩玩儿，所以他和朋友坐墓地在祭拜⟧ — her note: loosely connected with the preceding sentence
  her past correction: 孟子在墓地[-和]祭拜跟其他孩子
  her past correction: 孟子在墓地和[祭拜跟其他孩子→跟其他孩子祭拜]

[I52] 但是他妈妈觉得这是【不合适的地方让孩子玩】   correction: 不合适的地方让孩子玩 → 不适合让孩子玩的地方   strength: error
  checker's note: the modifier and verb phrase are in the wrong order
  rule card (verb_object_valency, Grammar): Use the verb structure that the verb allows: give it the needed object, and do not add an extra object after a V.+Obj. compound or complement. For example, 跑遍 + place, while 掉 cannot take an object by itself.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <verb/verb phrase> must take <the allowed object or complement structure>; <brief reason, such as “it is a V.+Obj. compound” or “the action is durative, so use 着durative”>.  Her terms: 着durative, 跑遍 + place, 管事V.+Obj. compound, 掉 + directional + place, resultative complement
  her past correction: 而是她觉得墓地[不合适→不适合]孩子们玩
  her past correction: 孟母觉得这个环境[不对孩子的成长有→对孩子的成长没有]好处
  her past correction: 就自己觉得我不想[我的儿子→儿子不应该]在这个地方长大

[I53] 所以她决定【了】他们会搬家找更好的地方   correction: 了 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: no 了 after the mental-state verb 决定
  rule card (no_le_mental_state, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Mental-state verbs such as 决定 and 发现 normally do not take 了 when they express a decision or discovery in the narrative.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <verb> is a mental-state verb here, so use no 了.  Her terms: mental state verb, no了
  her past correction: 所以[他们→我们]要搬家 — her note: in quoted speech
  her past correction: 所以他们[再→又]搬家一次 — her note: 又for something already occurred
  her past correction: 所以他们[再搬家→又搬家了] — her note: 又for something already occurred

[I54] 所以她决定了他们会搬家找更好的【地方】   correction: 地方 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (redundant_words, Other): Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <deleted part> is redundant because <the remaining word(s)> already expresses this meaning.  Her terms: redundant, redundant with是, redundant with看起来
  her past correction: 他们搬家不是为了[-孟母]要住在更好的房子 — her note: delete孟母
  her past correction: 他们搬家不是为了孟母要住在更好的房子[+里] — her note: 在+Place
  her past correction: 所以[他们→我们]要搬家 — her note: in quoted speech

[I55] 而且【住在这儿】教育不太好   correction: 住在这儿 → 这儿的   strength: error
  checker's note: the location should modify 教育 with 的
  rule card (verb_object_valency, Grammar): Use the verb structure that the verb allows: give it the needed object, and do not add an extra object after a V.+Obj. compound or complement. For example, 跑遍 + place, while 掉 cannot take an object by itself.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <verb/verb phrase> must take <the allowed object or complement structure>; <brief reason, such as “it is a V.+Obj. compound” or “the action is durative, so use 着durative”>.  Her terms: 着durative, 跑遍 + place, 管事V.+Obj. compound, 掉 + directional + place, resultative complement
  her past correction: 但这个地方不是[教育意义→教导孩子学习知识]
  her past correction: 我现在有良好的[-教育和]生活
  her past correction: 也[-她]感到孩子教育的好地方

[I56] 所以【她】会一直搬家才能找到质量好的教育   correction: 她 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 她 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: 也她[感到孩子教育的好地方→就找到了让孩子接受良好教育的环境]
  her past correction: [-也]她感到孩子教育的好地方
  her past correction: 也[-她]感到孩子教育的好地方

[I57] 所以她【会】一直搬家才能找到质量好的教育   correction: 会 → 要   strength: error
  checker's note: 要...才能 is the appropriate conditional pattern
  rule card (collocation_selection, Vocabulary): Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <word/expression> does not normally collocate with <noun/action/situation>; use <correct> instead.  Her terms: Time + 期间, V.得很厉害, 着durative, no了for habit/routine
  her past correction: 也她[感到孩子教育的好地方→就找到了让孩子接受良好教育的环境]
  her past correction: [-也]她感到孩子教育的好地方
  her past correction: 也[-她]感到孩子教育的好地方

items.explanation: 孟子 appears for the first time, so please briefly introduce him, for example 孟子小时候.
It would be more natural to say 去墓地玩儿 without 了 here; this sentence can then connect more smoothly to the following reason.
不合适的地方让孩子玩 → 不适合让孩子玩的地方: use 不适合 + 人 + V. to show that the place is not suitable for children to play in.
items.corrected: 不适合让孩子玩的地方

items.explanation: 决定 is a mental state verb here, so use no 了.
It would be more natural to delete 地方 because 更好的 already expresses the idea of finding something better.
住在这儿 → 这儿的: use 这儿的 to modify 教育. The place needs 的 before the noun it describes.
她 is already clear from the previous clause, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.
会 does not normally collocate with 才能 in this conditional pattern; use 要……才能.
